description: Each month, long the 3 currency futures with the strongest 12-month return (skipping the last month) and short the 3 weakest. Falsified if cross-sectional currency momentum has decayed since publication. Backtested on FinzData currency futures: front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar as an excess-return index, so the interest-rate differential (carry) is in the return; costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: Currency futures momentum 12-1 · long/short · top 3 of 9 (after Menkhoff, Sarno, Schmeling & Schrimpf 2012)
